    <!-- Thin progress bar for continue-watching tiles. Invisible unless the
    ListItem actually has a PercentPlayed value set, so it never affects any
    row other than Continue Watching (no other row sets that property).
    Included from widget_layout_poster in IncludesHomeWidgets.xml, after the
    title-panel overlay, so it paints on top of that panel's background
    instead of being hidden underneath it. -->
    <include name="ContinueWatchingProgressBar">
        <control type="progress">
            <description>Continue watching progress bar</description>
            <visible>Integer.IsGreater(ListItem.PercentPlayed,0)</visible>
            <left>8</left>
            <bottom>10</bottom>
            <width>223</width>
            <height>5</height>
            <texturebg colordiffuse="80000000">diffuse/panel2.png</texturebg>
            <lefttexture/>
            <midtexture colordiffuse="FFFFD700">diffuse/panel2.png</midtexture>
            <righttexture/>
            <info>ListItem.PercentPlayed</info>
        </control>
    </include>
